pages.title: Recall Accepted
pages.text: Travel between two Recall Platforms on the same working network.

pages.title: Recall Accepted
pages.text: Pillars and Soul Gems support network expansion after real travel between its two platforms.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Link both platforms to one Tesla Network and use native travel. The network rejects self-links and excessive distances. Placing two platforms does not prove transfer.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Connect Dinamo, Tesla components and two Recall Platforms with a Wrench. Travel works only within the same network.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Use Wrench to link Tesla nodes, select the top Voltaic Pillar and build equal-height pillar columns. Self-links and overlong connections are rejected; Voltaic Relay extends the connection chain.

pages.title: Related possibilities
pages.text: Power Plasma Lamps through Tesla Coil and linked network blocks, or use Recall Platforms. The native tooltips distinguish lighting, continuous current and inter-platform teleportation.
